meta.inspection: All 25 images individually opened; no keys/source/other judges inspected. Static phone-like landscape assessment.
meta.anchors: Recognizable unchanged controls retain exact prior scores.
meta.blinding_limitations: Related capture families and repeated controls recognizable. Sci-fi reference resembles StarCraft and battlefield references Company of Heroes; tactical reference title uncertain. No verified identity or iteration order used.

view-01.png.evidence: Crisp continuous deck, narrow rim and raised island remain coherent amid dense aircraft; long wake evident.
view-01.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Pale planes merge with tan deck, player partly occluded, smoke dots repetitive. Unchanged anchor.

view-02.png.evidence: Raised island with larger side/shadow and visible dark hull face gives carrier height. Player silhouette is larger and outlined; wake clear.
view-02.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Player overlays pale runway and appears partly merged with markings. Island shadow is a hard block; broader forward hull face almost black.

view-03.png.evidence: Warm market shadows, worn paving, varied produce and props provide rich materials; colored routes traceable.
view-03.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Small brown figures blend into surroundings. Unchanged reference anchor.

view-04.png.evidence: Gray clustered particles and orange fire have more shaped texture than pale dots; ship side/island create height.
view-04.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Severe clutter: identical gray clusters cover aircraft and deck, orange flecks have near-equal emphasis everywhere, and large blurred dark shadows add another repeated shape layer. Player ring barely separates the focal aircraft.

view-05.png.evidence: Raised hangar walls and roof planes, service compound, tall tree shading and shore rocks show stronger vertical structure.
view-05.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Blue player directly overlaps blue roof despite outline. Very mottled grass competes with small props; pale cyan patch on upper hangar reads as an unexplained attached slab. Shore remains plain.

view-06.png.evidence: Single outlined aircraft, dark top bars and continuous tan carrier deck create strong hierarchy; wake present.
view-06.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Soft edges, uniform deck light and paired wake remain simple. Unchanged anchor.

view-07.png.evidence: Crisp roof walls, vehicle compound, dirt lanes and muted shaded trees create organized base; player outline helps.
view-07.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Tiny service blocks and heavy dark tree shadows remain; shoreline flat. Unchanged anchor.

view-08.png.evidence: Larger outlined plane and deeper building/tree shadows improve height and separation. Shore rocks and partial compound add structure.
view-08.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Plane overlaps beach rock, grass is noisier and dark circular tree contacts heavy. Enlarged aircraft consumes more of quiet land focal area without extra material detail.

view-09.png.evidence: Fog layers, autumn trees, tracks and damaged structures create atmospheric depth.
view-09.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Tiny units merge with terrain/haze. Unchanged reference anchor.

view-10.png.evidence: Outlined player separates at stern; continuous panels, raised island and narrow rim coherent; clear trailing wake.
view-10.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Uniform deck light and paired blurred wake still simple. Unchanged anchor.

view-11.png.evidence: Tan continuous deck and dark rim coherent, local player outline and long wake support focus.
view-11.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Pale aircraft overlap deck and each other; repeated smoke/spark dots lack hierarchy. Unchanged anchor.

view-12.png.evidence: Crisp raised island sides, mast and dark hull edge convey height; larger outlined aircraft has a clear silhouette; wake visible.
view-12.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Plane overlaps runway marks, hull face almost black and island shadow solid. Material response remains mostly flat fills.

view-13.png.evidence: Wet highlights, rain, smoke and tracer unify richly textured mud/rubble.
view-13.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Infantry and dark tanks merge with ground at phone size. Unchanged reference anchor.

view-14.png.evidence: Crisp outlined plane and muted shaded trees separate over olive terrain; rocks and partial compound enrich coast.
view-14.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Uniform noisy land, dark tree contacts and simple shore remain. Unchanged anchor.

view-15.png.evidence: Outlined plane separates from grass and rocks; muted trees fit terrain and partial compound adds land use.
view-15.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Central grass remains flat, dark shadows repeated. Unchanged anchor.

view-16.png.evidence: Crisp continuous deck, narrow rim and raised island coherent; outlined player and wake visible.
view-16.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Light aircraft on deck remain crowded; wake is soft and paired. Unchanged anchor.

view-17.png.evidence: Raised island and larger aircraft give height; gray smoke clusters and orange fire make active hits more apparent.
view-17.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Smoke resembles granular gray debris and overlaps deck/planes; broad dark aircraft shadows pull attention. Player partly merges with stern details.

view-18.png.evidence: Larger outlined player, raised hangars and stronger tree shadows imply altitude and structure.
view-18.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Busy grass and large dark contacts compete with plane; plane overlaps shoreline rocks and beach remains simple flat strip.

view-19.png.evidence: Raised hangar walls, roof planes, service compound and road structure create coherent airfield volume.
view-19.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Player remains merged with blue roof; pale cyan top-roof shape seems disconnected from roof material. Noisy grass softens object distinction.

view-20.png.evidence: Distinct floors, thick walls, warm/cool lighting and furniture contact shadows give clear interior depth.
view-20.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Tiny units and labels demanding at phone size. Unchanged reference anchor.

view-21.png.evidence: Muted trees, compound vehicles, dirt lanes and hangar walls give purposeful base terrain; outline separates player better.
view-21.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Compound tiny and player still overlaps roof. Dark tree shadows heavy. Unchanged anchor.

view-22.png.evidence: Crisper raised ship/island, orange impact flecks and granular smoke have stronger physical detail; long wake maintained.
view-22.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Clusters resemble debris more than soft smoke, occlude deck, and have repeated rosette shapes. Large dark blurred aircraft shadows are distracting; player ring is crowded.

view-23.png.evidence: Continuous tan deck, narrow shaded rim and island shadow coherent; outline and long wake aid location.
view-23.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Pale planes blend with deck markings and hull lighting remains limited. Unchanged anchor.

view-24.png.evidence: Detailed metallic ships and cool rock terrain contrast with layered bright explosion and debris.
view-24.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Blast obscures units and purple shapes merge with foliage. Unchanged reference anchor.

view-25.png.evidence: Crisp textured smoke clusters, hot orange fire and raised carrier structure show more detail/height.
view-25.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: High-density gray rosettes obscure units, repeated flames lack hierarchy, and dark blurred shadows resemble extra threats. More detailed effects reduce phone-scale readability substantially.

general_next_priorities: Prioritize dense-fight legibility: new gray rosette particles and orange flecks cover the play area. Fewer larger semitransparent plumes and clearly ranked impact cores would communicate events better.
Reduce the contrast and uniformity of large blurred aircraft shadows; their repeated dark disks become competing objects.
Keep building and ship height cues but soften near-black side/shadow slabs with coherent lighting and selected material variation.
Player outline helps over terrain, yet blue aircraft overlapping blue roofs and busy deck remains unresolved. Use a stable focal marker or smarter local separation.
Reduce grass texture contrast/frequency so service vehicles, trees and aircraft gain separation; add purposeful ground wear instead.
Keep attached long wakes; their soft paired-strip shape still limits realism. No improvement in animation quality inferred from static frames.
